(function() {
  var MAX_RELOAD_ATTEMPTS = 3;
  var RELOAD_ATTEMPT_KEY = 'chunk_reload_attempts';
  var RELOAD_TIMESTAMP_KEY = 'chunk_reload_timestamp';
  var RELOAD_COOLDOWN_MS = 60000;
  
  function isChunkLoadError(error) {
    var msg = typeof error === 'string' ? error : (error && error.message) || '';
    var name = typeof error === 'string' ? '' : (error && error.name) || '';
    return name === 'ChunkLoadError' || 
           msg.indexOf('Loading chunk') !== -1 || 
           msg.indexOf('ChunkLoadError') !== -1 ||
           msg.indexOf('dynamically imported module') !== -1;
  }
  
  function extractChunkUrl(error) {
    var msg = typeof error === 'string' ? error : (error && error.message) || '';
    var match = msg.match(/(https?:\/\/[^\s)]+\.js)/i);
    if (match) return match[0];
    var pathMatch = msg.match(/\/_next\/static\/chunks\/[^\s)]+\.js/i);
    return pathMatch ? window.location.origin + pathMatch[0] : null;
  }
  
  function getReloadAttempts() {
    try { return parseInt(sessionStorage.getItem(RELOAD_ATTEMPT_KEY) || '0', 10); } 
    catch (e) { return 0; }
  }
  
  function incrementReloadAttempts() {
    try {
      var attempts = getReloadAttempts() + 1;
      sessionStorage.setItem(RELOAD_ATTEMPT_KEY, String(attempts));
      sessionStorage.setItem(RELOAD_TIMESTAMP_KEY, String(Date.now()));
      return attempts;
    } catch (e) { return 0; }
  }
  
  function isInCooldown() {
    try {
      var ts = sessionStorage.getItem(RELOAD_TIMESTAMP_KEY);
      return ts && (Date.now() - parseInt(ts, 10) < RELOAD_COOLDOWN_MS);
    } catch (e) { return false; }
  }
  
  async function clearCachesAndReload() {
    try {
      if ('caches' in window) {
        var names = await caches.keys();
        await Promise.all(names.map(function(n) { return caches.delete(n); }));
      }
      if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
        var regs = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations();
        await Promise.all(regs.map(function(r) { return r.unregister(); }));
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    
    window.location.reload();
  }
  
  async function handleChunkError(error) {
    if (getReloadAttempts() >= MAX_RELOAD_ATTEMPTS || isInCooldown()) return;
    
    var chunkUrl = extractChunkUrl(error);
    var reloadAttempt = incrementReloadAttempts();
    
    // Try to diagnose: is it a 404 or network error?
    if (chunkUrl && reloadAttempt === 1) {
      try {
        var retryUrl = chunkUrl + '?retry=' + Date.now();
        var response = await fetch(retryUrl, { cache: 'no-store', method: 'HEAD' });
        
        // Track diagnosis in PostHog
        if (window.posthog) {
          window.posthog.capture('chunk_load_error_diagnosis', {
            chunk_url: chunkUrl,
            status: response.status,
            status_text: response.statusText,
            is_404: response.status === 404,
            page_url: window.location.href,
            user_agent: navigator.userAgent
          });
        }
        
        if (response.ok) {
          // Chunk exists now, just reload
          window.location.reload();
          return;
        }
      } catch (fetchError) {
        // Network error during diagnosis
        if (window.posthog) {
          window.posthog.capture('chunk_load_error_diagnosis', {
            chunk_url: chunkUrl,
            status: 'network_error',
            fetch_error: fetchError.message || 'Unknown',
            page_url: window.location.href
          });
        }
      }
    }
    
    // Track the main error in PostHog
    if (window.posthog) {
      window.posthog.capture('chunk_load_error', {
        error_message: typeof error === 'string' ? error : (error && error.message) || 'Unknown',
        chunk_url: chunkUrl,
        reload_attempt: reloadAttempt,
        is_safari: /Safari/i.test(navigator.userAgent) && !/Chrome|CriOS/i.test(navigator.userAgent),
        page_url: window.location.href
      });
    }
    
    clearCachesAndReload();
  }
  
  window.onerror = function(msg, src, line, col, err) {
    if (err && isChunkLoadError(err)) { handleChunkError(err); return true; }
    if (typeof msg === 'string' && isChunkLoadError(msg)) { handleChunkError(msg); return true; }
    return false;
  };
  
  window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', function(e) {
    if (e.reason && isChunkLoadError(e.reason)) { e.preventDefault(); handleChunkError(e.reason); }
  });
  
  window.addEventListener('error', function(e) {
    if (e.target instanceof HTMLScriptElement && e.target.src && e.target.src.indexOf('/_next/') !== -1) {
      handleChunkError('Failed to load: ' + e.target.src);
    }
  }, true);
  
  // Reset attempts on successful load
  window.addEventListener('load', function() {
    setTimeout(function() {
      try { sessionStorage.removeItem(RELOAD_ATTEMPT_KEY); } catch (e) {}
    }, 1000);
  });
  
  window.__CHUNK_ERROR_HANDLER_INITIALIZED__ = true;
})();
